---
name: Feature request (RFC)
about: Propose a change to the language or the tools
title: "RFC: "
labels: rfc
---

**The problem.** What you're trying to model or check, and why Haze can't do it well today.

**The proposal.** A small model written with the feature, and the output you'd expect.

**Alternatives.** Other ways to get the same result, in Haze or elsewhere.
